title: Estimating and Scoping
description: Estimate AI-assisted work honestly, including the review time that is now the bulk of it — and scope it around a week that has bad days in it.

title: Accountability, Licensing and Disclosure
description: Know what you owe a client or employer about how the code was produced, what you carry if it's wrong, and when disclosure is honest instead of theatre.

title: Working With a Team, and Without One
description: Collaborate on AI-assisted code asynchronously, on your own hours, without becoming a bottleneck — and build a review habit for the days there's no one else to ask.

title: Cost, Limits and Tool Independence
description: Work with a clear picture of what your AI tools actually cost, where they fail, and what happens — to the work and to your own skill — when they're gone.

title: Capstone — Ship and Defend a Change
description: Take one real change from request to shipped, and defend every significant decision in it — scoping, review, disclosure and all, applied together on one real piece of work.
